title: Mitarbeiter Datenmanagement & KI (m/w/d)
description: Sie verstehen Daten, denken in Prozessen und haben Freude daran, digitale Abläufe zu verbessern? Dann gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Versicherungsverwaltung. Die Finanz Protect GmbH ist ein Finanz- und Versicherungsmakler mit Sitz am Phoenixsee in Dortmund und betreut Kunden bundesweit. Wir wachsen und suchen Unterstützung für unser Daten- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Automatisierungs- und KI-Prozesse. Bei uns sorgen Sie dafür, dass Kunden- und Vertragsdaten zuverlässig verarbeitet werden, Systeme miteinander kommunizieren und aus manuellen Arbeitsschritten effiziente digitale Abläufe werden. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Team und externen Softwarepartnern zusammen. Aufgaben Datenmanagement und Datenqualität: Sie pflegen und strukturieren Kunden- und Vertragsdaten in unserem Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, erkennen Dubletten und Unstimmigkeiten und sorgen für eine verlässliche Datenbasis. BiPRO-Abruf: Sie richten digitale Abrufe von Versicherungsdokumenten und Daten ein, überwachen deren Verarbeitung und stellen die korrekte Zuordnung zu Kunden und Verträgen sicher. GDV-Datenverarbeitung: Sie importieren und verarbeiten GDV-Bestandsdaten, gleichen diese mit vorhandenen Datensätzen ab und klären fehlerhafte oder unvollständige Übertragungen. Schnittstellenmanagement: Sie betreuen die Anbindungen zwischen Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, Versicherern, Maklerpools und weiteren Anwendungen. Bei Störungen koordinieren Sie die Fehleranalyse und Behebung mit den jeweiligen Ansprechpartnern. Bestandsintegration: Sie unterstützen die Übernahme zugekaufter Versicherungsbestände durch die Aufbereitung, Übertragung und Qualitätskontrolle der Kunden- und Vertragsdaten. Automatisierung: Sie identifizieren wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben und entwickeln automatisierte Abläufe, beispielsweise für Dokumentenzuordnung, Datenpflege und interne Bearbeitungsprozesse. KI- Prozesse: Sie erproben und integrieren KI-Anwendungen für die Dokumentenerkennung, Informationsextraktion und Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft. Dabei prüfen Sie die Ergebnisse auf Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit. Dokumentation und Wissenstransfer: Sie dokumentieren Abläufe verständlich und unterstützen das Team bei der sicheren Anwendung neuer digitaler Prozesse. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Versicherungsbereich, in der IT oder im kaufmännischen Bereich mit ausgeprägtem technischem Schwerpunkt – oder über vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung. Sie bringen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Versicherungsdaten, Maklerverwaltungsprogrammen oder digitalen Verwaltungsprozessen mit. Kenntnisse in BiPRO, GDV-Datenverarbeitung und Schnittstellenmanagement sind besonders willkommen. In einzelne Themen können Sie sich bei entsprechender Vorerfahrung und Lernbereitschaft einarbeiten. Sie arbeiten sicher mit Excel und können Daten strukturiert aufbereiten, abgleichen und auf Fehler prüfen. Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit Automatisierungswerkzeugen wie Make oder Power Automate beziehungsweise großes Interesse, sich darin zu vertiefen. Sie nutzen KI-Anwendungen praxisorientiert und können beurteilen, an welchen Stellen diese sinnvoll eingesetzt werden und wo eine menschliche Prüfung erforderlich bleibt. Kenntnisse in APIs, Datenformaten wie CSV, XML oder JSON sowie grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Sie arbeiten sorgfältig, analytisch und eigenverantwortlich. Auch bei komplexen Datenbeständen behalten Sie den Überblick und gehen Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund. Sie gehen verantwortungsbewusst mit sensiblen Kunden- und Vertragsdaten um und können technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln. Benefits Unsere Benefits für Mitarbeiter/innen: Eine Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf unsere digitale Weiterentwicklung Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien Modernes Büro im RIVA-Gebäude am Phoenixsee in Dortmund Moderne Software, KI-Anwendungen und technische Ausstattung Monatliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung Flexibles Gleitzeitmodell Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen für eigene Versicherungen und Depots Betriebliche Altersversorgung mit Zuschuss Über 300 Gesundheitsleistungen, darunter Physiotherapie, Zahnreinigung, Brillenzuschüsse und Massagen Premium-Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft inklusive Sauna Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische und ergonomische Bürostühle Kostenfreie Getränke wie Wasser, Kaffee und Softdrinks Bei der Finanz Protect GmbH legen wir großen Wert auf das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter . Wir bieten Ihnen nicht nur spannende Aufgaben und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten , sondern auch attraktive Benefits , um Ihnen den Arbeitsalltag angenehm zu gestalten. Sie möchten Daten nicht nur verwalten, sondern dafür sorgen, dass Prozesse besser funktionieren? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf und erzählen Sie uns kurz, mit welchen Systemen, Schnittstellen oder Automatisierungen Sie bereits gearbeitet haben. You'll create and run campaigns that ensure our customers know about our latest products and features as well as grow our customer advocacy program. You'll also manage our relationships with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and other tier-1 firms, driving everything from briefings and evaluations to an ongoing calendar of analyst engagement.

If you've built narratives around products and features that drive customer behavior and advocacy, but are also interested in gaining more experience in analyst relations, this is the role for you.

 
 

What You'll Do

Customer Marketing

  • Design and run lifecycle campaigns that drive product and feature awareness among the existing customer base

  • Build and execute adoption campaigns in partnership with Product and Customer Success that move customers from awareness to active usage of new and underutilized features

  • Produce a steady cadence of compelling customer stories across formats: written case studies, video, slide-ready summaries, and co-branded content

  • Build and manage a customer reference and advocacy program — identifying, recruiting, and nurturing customer advocates without burning them out

  • Identify and develop upsell-ready customer segments — working with Product Marketing, CS and Sales to create marketing programs that convert engaged, high-adoption customers into expansion pipeline for additional products

Analyst Relations

  • Own management of the AR program: help design annual strategy, briefing preparation, inquiry management, evaluation cycles, and ongoing analyst engagement

  • Manage our presence in major analyst evaluations (Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, etc) — from submission strategy through final publication

  • Lead briefing preparation: working across product, product marketing, and leadership to build crisp, evidence-backed narratives and prep executive spokespeople

  • Maintain an AR intelligence function — tracking analyst sentiment, surfacing relevant research, and feeding competitive and market insights back to product and go-to-market teams

  • Help maintain genuine relationships with tier-1 and tier-2 analysts, understanding what each analyst cares about and tailoring our engagement accordingly

 
 

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in customer marketing: running campaigns specifically designed to drive customer engagement (product adoption and advocacy)

  • Has run multiple customer-focused programs end-to-end (loyalty campaigns, onboarding journeys, expansion/upsell plays, customer advisory boards, etc)

  • Heavy involvement in content creation — case studies, customer stories, or executive communications

  • Experience working with CRM data (Salesforce) and customer lifecycle metrics (NPS, CSAT, expansion signals)

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with product, sales, and executive stakeholders to gather input and drive alignment

Preferred

  • Has managed a customer reference or advocacy program

  • Experience managing analyst relations, especially Gartner and Forrester including writing briefing documents and/or positioning narratives

 
 

Skills

  • Exceptional storyteller who turns product capabilities into crisp, compelling stories

  • Deep comfort with technical or complex products and familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals

  • Excellent project management and attention to detail, able to manage complex initiatives from concept to execution

  • A growth mindset with creativity, ambition, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation.

 
 

Mindset

title: Senior Strategy & Project Manager (m/w/d)
description: Als Senior Strategy & Project Manager im Management Office verantwortest du eigenständig strategische Projekte mit hohem Business Impact und unterstützt primär unsere Geschäftsführung als analytischer Sparringspartner bei zentralen unternehmerischen Fragestellungen. Du treibst High-Impact-Initiativen voran, behältst die relevanten KPIs im Blick und trägst so unmittelbar zur erfolgreichen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von LIQID bei. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, tiefgehende Einblicke in das Management und die verschiedensten Bereiche eines der innovativsten Scale-Ups im Bereich Financial Services zu gewinnen und direkten Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung von LIQID zu nehmen. Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Aufgrund der Nähe zum Senior Management ist eine hohe Präsenz im Berliner Büro Voraussetzung. Was machst du dabei konkret? Strategische Projekte: Du leitest High-Impact-Initiativen end-to-end, treibst deren Umsetzung voran und bist dabei inhaltlich tief in den Themen involviert, um die bestmöglichen Lösungen zu erarbeiten. Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung: Du hast einen Blick auf alle relevanten KPIs, leitest fundierte Empfehlungen ab und trägst dazu bei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu treffen. Für unsere Geschäftsführung bist du dabei ein Key Sparrings Partner. Business Impact & strategische Analysen: Du erstellst Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Business Cases und Analysen zu zentralen strategischen Fragestellungen und stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten effizient umgesetzt werden. Business Transformation: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen innerhalb eines oder über Teams hinweg und treibst die kontinuierliche organisatorische Weiterentwicklung. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Executive und Leadership Teams sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen, koordinierst über Teamgrenzen hinweg und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung. Stakeholder Management : Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO, der Geschäftsführung und externen Stakeholdern. Du pflegst du den Kontakt zu Partnern und Investoren, bereitest Updates und Unterlagen vor und unterstützt den CEO und die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Diskussionen. Das bringst du mit: Akademischer Background: Ein exzellenter Abschluss einer Top-Tier Business School, Wirtschafts- oder Technischen Universität mit Schwerpunkt auf Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen. Berufserfahrung: mind. 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich Strategieberatung, Investment Banking, Private Equity oder Venture Capital bzw. in einer vergleichbaren strategischen Rolle (idealerweise mit Bezug zu Financial Services oder Tech Scale-Ups). Projektmanagement: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung und Umsetzung komplexer Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern. Analytische & strategische Fähigkeiten: Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Zahlen und ein hohes Maß an Detailorientierung. Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, Durchsetzungsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld pragmatische Lösungen zu finden. Das bieten wir dir: Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Kurzes Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team: Ein entspannter erster Austausch, bei dem wir uns gegenseitig kennenlernen. Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: Wir besprechen, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Rolle zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Case Study: Wir möchten sehen, wie du komplexe Herausforderungen angehst und deine Problemlösungskompetenz anhand eines realistischen Arbeitsszenarios unter Beweis stellst. Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du lernst das Team kennen und erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in den Arbeitsalltag. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt. What you bring

  • Background: Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program in Economics, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, preferably with a focus on management, IT, or design.

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity for data-driven decision making. Comfortable tackling complex problems and breaking them down into actionable steps.

  • Curiosity: Passion for fintech, technology, and creating meaningful customer experiences. Motivated to learn by doing and explore new challenges.

  • Ownership & Initiative: Proactive, hands-on, able to take ownership of tasks and small projects, and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent communication skills, collaborate openly, and build strong relationships across Product, Design, and Engineering teams.

  • Language Skills: Fluency in German and English.

  • Availability: Full-time availability for minimum 3 months and the ability to travel to the LIQID HQ in Berlin (hybrid working)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Linear, Figma, Webflow, JavaScript or other tech/product tools.

  • Prior experience in start-ups, consulting, or financial services.


Don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to receiving your application!

 

What we offer

  • Ownership & Learning: Real exposure to product development with responsibility to make an impact. You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory.

  • Flexible Work & Tools: Hybrid working options, 28 vacation days and two additional days off on December 24 and 31, high-quality equipment (MacBook, display, headphones) and a supportive environment to balance learning and work.

description: TL;DR We are hiring a Product Engineering Tech Lead to own the layer that runs our customers' AI applications: serverless, durable, streaming execution, and the observability that proves it works. You sit where backend engineering, platform operations, and product meet. You scale this platform to enterprise grade, push it into new territory like long running autonomous agents, lead the team that builds it, and own the result end to end. This is a builder role with a founder mindset, not a maintainer role. Why deepset At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. We’re remote-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world. What you will do Own the serverless execution platform. Pipelines and agents need to run fast, reliably, and concurrently at enterprise scale, and they need to behave identically whether invoked serverless or running as a deployed service. You'll architect the execution layer that makes that true, including the durability work (surviving node evictions, spot terminations, rolling deploys) needed to keep long-running agents alive for hours, not seconds. Own streaming and long-lived connections. Conversational and agentic workloads here are long-lived, not simple request/responses. You'll own how those connections behave under pressure: backpressure, graceful shutdown, reconnects, for both end users and API clients. Lead the team and the architecture. Set technical direction, make the hard tradeoffs, and translate product strategy into a system that holds up under enterprise load. You stay hands-on on the problems that matter most, even as your day-to-day coding share shifts over time. Make reliability provable. Own observability and metering: tracing, alerting, per-customer cost and usage visibility, so the platform's reliability isn't just a claim, it's something you can show a customer. You'll also own on-call and incident response, closing the loop between what you build and what you operate. What you bring to the team Builder and founder mindset. You have started things, shipped them, and lived with the consequences. You think about what is next, not only about fixing what is in front of you. Startup or founder experience is a strong signal here. You have built and operated systems on Kubernetes in production, and you are comfortable working from the ground up. This role is not about owning one slice of an existing system, or only operating infrastructure someone else designed. It is product work: building something new and owning the outcome. Durable execution experience. You have worked with durable, fault tolerant execution: retries, failover, durable state, and human in the loop. You understand the failure modes, not just the happy path. Serverless and function platforms at scale. Knative, KEDA, OpenFaaS, Fission, or similar. You know scale to zero, warm pools, cold start tradeoffs, and per request isolation. Streaming and long running workloads. Server sent events or websockets, long lived connections, and the operational reality of keeping them alive through deploys and node churn. Agentic or AI workloads are a plus. Operator instinct. Observability, alerting, service levels, and incident response are second nature. You hold the platform to a production grade standard because it has to work reliably for real customers. You can lead a team and connect strategy to robust architecture. You make the technical direction legible to the rest of the team and to the business. Comfortable in Python and with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) in a cloud native stack. Nice to have Built Kubernetes operators or controllers, or automated deployments as a system rather than a script. Taken a platform from zero to one all the way to production grade ownership. Open source contribution or maintenance background. Exposure to B2B SaaS, LLM, or agent infrastructure. raw.title: Product Engineering Tech Lead
raw.description:
TL;DR

We are hiring a Product Engineering Tech Lead to own the layer that runs our customers' AI applications: serverless, durable, streaming execution, and the observability that proves it works. You sit where backend engineering, platform operations, and product meet. You scale this platform to enterprise grade, push it into new territory like long running autonomous agents, lead the team that builds it, and own the result end to end. This is a builder role with a founder mindset, not a maintainer role.

Why deepset

At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. We’re remote-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Own the serverless execution platform. Pipelines and agents need to run fast, reliably, and concurrently at enterprise scale, and they need to behave identically whether invoked serverless or running as a deployed service. You'll architect the execution layer that makes that true, including the durability work (surviving node evictions, spot terminations, rolling deploys) needed to keep long-running agents alive for hours, not seconds.

  • Own streaming and long-lived connections. Conversational and agentic workloads here are long-lived, not simple request/responses. You'll own how those connections behave under pressure: backpressure, graceful shutdown, reconnects, for both end users and API clients.

  • Lead the team and the architecture. Set technical direction, make the hard tradeoffs, and translate product strategy into a system that holds up under enterprise load. You stay hands-on on the problems that matter most, even as your day-to-day coding share shifts over time.

  • Make reliability provable. Own observability and metering: tracing, alerting, per-customer cost and usage visibility, so the platform's reliability isn't just a claim, it's something you can show a customer. You'll also own on-call and incident response, closing the loop between what you build and what you operate.

What you bring to the team

  • Builder and founder mindset. You have started things, shipped them, and lived with the consequences. You think about what is next, not only about fixing what is in front of you. Startup or founder experience is a strong signal here.

  • You have built and operated systems on Kubernetes in production, and you are comfortable working from the ground up. This role is not about owning one slice of an existing system, or only operating infrastructure someone else designed. It is product work: building something new and owning the outcome.

  • Durable execution experience. You have worked with durable, fault tolerant execution: retries, failover, durable state, and human in the loop. You understand the failure modes, not just the happy path.

  • Serverless and function platforms at scale. Knative, KEDA, OpenFaaS, Fission, or similar. You know scale to zero, warm pools, cold start tradeoffs, and per request isolation.

  • Streaming and long running workloads. Server sent events or websockets, long lived connections, and the operational reality of keeping them alive through deploys and node churn. Agentic or AI workloads are a plus.

  • Operator instinct. Observability, alerting, service levels, and incident response are second nature. You hold the platform to a production grade standard because it has to work reliably for real customers.

  • You can lead a team and connect strategy to robust architecture. You make the technical direction legible to the rest of the team and to the business.

  • Comfortable in Python and with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) in a cloud native stack.

Nice to have

  • Built Kubernetes operators or controllers, or automated deployments as a system rather than a script.

  • Taken a platform from zero to one all the way to production grade ownership.

  • Open source contribution or maintenance background.

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS, LLM, or agent infrastructure.

Benefits

  • Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice

  • 30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave

  • Competitive salary & stock options for every team member

  • Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Monthly team socials & in-person meetups

  • Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

About us

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. Backed by GV and Balderton, we’re growing the world’s production AI community and customer base solving challenges too critical to get wrong.

End-to-End Fallbearbeitung: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für Bestell- und Lieferthemen wie Retouren, Transportschäden, Rückerstattungen und Reklamationen von der Ersterfassung bis zur finalen Lösung gemäß lokaler SOPs. Crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Logistik, Lager, Vertrieb sowie Technik zusammen und pflegst eine lückenlose Dokumentation in Zendesk, Shopify und internen Systemen für reibungslose Übergaben. Internationales Team – Arbeite mit engagierten Kolleg:innen aus ganz Europa zusammen und profitiere von vielfältigen Perspektiven und Ideen. title: Werkstudent:in Content & Social Media (m/w/d)
description: Worum es geht Wir sind OK ROGER. Im Kern eine Markenberatung: Unsere Kunden können etwas — nur sieht man es ihnen oft nicht an. Zwischen dem, was sie sind, und dem, was ankommt, liegt Rauschen. Wir räumen es weg. Aber Markenberatung ist nur eine Sparte. Wir wachsen gerade stark und unternehmerisch, in mehrere Richtungen gleichzeitig. Für dich heißt das: Du steigst über einen klaren Bereich ein — und bleibst nicht darauf beschränkt. Dein Einstieg ist die Content-Produktion für unsere Social-Media-Kunden. Das ist der Anfang, nicht die Decke. Weil wir wachsen, wächst die Rolle mit — in mehr Verantwortung, in neue Bereiche, so weit du willst. Was du bei uns machst Dein Einstieg: Content für unsere Kunden. Du produzierst Content: Redaktionsplanung, Grafik und Text, fertige Posts — mit eigener Handschrift. Du bringst eigene Ideen mit. Formate, Aufhänger, Posts — nicht nur Umsetzung, sondern Einfälle. Am Anfang arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite. Nach dem Onboarding übernimmst du eigene Kunden — du planst, produzierst und verantwortest ihren Auftritt, wir schauen nur noch an den richtigen Stellen drauf. Du holst Freigaben bei Kunden ein und stimmst Operatives ab. Die Kundenbeziehung selbst bleibt bei uns. Du hältst die Qualität, auch im Detail. Bei uns liest der Markt Sorgfalt als Substanz. Dein Blick über den Tellerrand. Du arbeitest eng mit uns zusammen und bekommst Einblick, wo andere Werkstudierende nie hinkommen: wie eine Beratung geführt wird, wie Entscheidungen fallen, wie aus einer Idee ein Unternehmen wird. Konkret packst du beim Aufbau eines weiteren unternehmerischen Projekts mit an, das wir gerade hochziehen. Ja, manches davon ist Organisieren und Mitdenken im Alltag. Aber nichts davon ist Beschäftigung — jede Aufgabe zeigt dir ein Stück davon, wie Unternehmen entstehen. So fängst du an — und wohin es gehen kann Wir werfen dich nicht ins kalte Wasser. Die ersten Wochen arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite und lernst, wie wir arbeiten. Danach wirst du Schritt für Schritt eigenständiger. Und dann? Bei uns führt kein einziger Weg nach oben, sondern mehrere nach vorne: Tiefer in den Content. Von einzelnen Posts zu eigenen Kunden, die du verantwortest. Breiter ins Unternehmen. You will join a collaborative technical environment and work across the AI/ML lifecycle, from understanding a business problem and developing a solution to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement within the regulated clinical-trial space.

As an AI Engineer, you would be responsible for:

  • Designing, building and operating production AI and machine learning solutions, including data pipelines, models and inference services.
  • Developing LLM-powered features using approaches such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent workflows, tool calling and structured outputs, with a focus on reliability, measurable quality and cost efficiency.
  • Delivering end-to-end machine learning workflows on Databricks, from data preparation and feature development through training and evaluation to batch and real-time deployment.
  • Maintaining quality in production through versioning, evaluation, monitoring and drift detection, and supporting the investigation and recovery of solutions when issues arise.
  • Collaborating with Product, Engineering, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business needs into scoped technical requirements, measurable success criteria and realistic delivery plans, including relevant data and privacy constraints.
  • Contributing to governance-ready data and AI practices covering quality, lineage, access, security, GDPR and responsible AI, including relevant EU AI Act requirements.
  • Working with technical and non-technical stakeholders to explain trade-offs and model limitations, gather feedback and help prioritize improvements based on their potential impact.
  • Reviewing peer contributions, documenting and sharing knowledge, developing reusable components and helping improve our shared libraries and Data & AI platform tooling.

We would like you to have: 

  • A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, together with strong English communication skills at C1 level.
  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Applied AI, Data Science or a related field, including experience taking at least one AI or machine learning solution from prototype into production.
  • Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent technologies, along with solid SQL and warehouse or lakehouse experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including several of the following: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow or Workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and deploying models beyond the experimentation stage, with an understanding of monitoring, reliability and production quality.
  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns such as RAG, prompt workflows and evaluation, as well as cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and CI/CD practices for machine learning, or the foundations and motivation to develop further in these areas.
  • The ability to independently deliver well-defined AI/ML tasks, collaborate with product and business stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs, model behavior and limitations to non-technical audiences.

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
description: Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll? 🚀 Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz. Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source . In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. Deine Benefits Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt. Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen. Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice . Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst. Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag. Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine. Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken. Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden. Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner. Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. Deine Aufgaben Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur. Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen. Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible. Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX. KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz. Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker , IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums. Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten. Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur . Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere. Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung , beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien. Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen. Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren. Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. Du suchst keinen Job, in dem du nur Tickets abarbeitest, sondern möchtest eine Linux und Open Source Landschaft wirklich mitgestalten? 🚀 Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10 minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die IT Landschaft und die Möglichkeiten, die du in dieser Rolle hast. Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you'll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact. raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Data Scientist

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you'll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact.

We're hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Data Science Organisation

We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Deliveroo. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.

Our community is highly active, with guest lectures, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process. Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not.

 

What You'll Be Doing

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Proactive Impact Delivery: You will independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work that aligns with business goals and metrics, operating with minimal guidance to provide high value to your team and the broader organisation. You will own delivery end-to-end, ensuring the delivery of fast, high-quality, solutions that meet business needs.

  • Navigating Ambiguity and Complexity: You will excel at deconstructing broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured technical roadmaps, managing projects that require both deep team-specific rigour and an understanding of how they intersect with adjacent systems.

  • Strategic Technical Execution: Drive strategic decision-making by selecting the most effective tool or method for the task, maintaining a focus on high-quality execution and measurable results. You will act as a well-trusted strategic partner to stakeholders, using analytics, effective communication and domain expertise to influence roadmaps.

  • Experimentation and measurement: Design and lead measurement strategies that drive product direction, ranging from simple A/B tests to complex experimental designs. You will be equally capable of applying alternative causal inference techniques when standard trials aren't feasible, ensuring the business moves based on data driven insights.

  • Organisational Alignment: Actively contribute to the broader Analytics community, driving L+D initiatives and cross-functional collaboration. You will ensure we are delivering the "right" things org-wide by aligning technical work with overarching business strategy and shared best practices.

     

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Significant experience in Data Science (or similar) roles.

  • A pragmatic and adaptable approach, with a strong focus on delivering impact efficiently at pace.

  • Excellent people skills — you'll be meeting with a range of both technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate business needs into data science problems

  • Experience leading both simple and more complex experiment designs, with the ability to proactively unpick insights to steer strategic decision making

  • Great communication skills - in person, in writing, in code; to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Through solid analysis, provide clear and actionable recommendations that influence the team's roadmap.

  • Effective problem-solving, demonstrating an ability to successfully address complex and ambiguous challenges.

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

  • Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL. Proficiency with Cursor/AI tools to deliver impactful, high quality work efficiently is also valued

     

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:


🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

 

​​💰 Share in the success you help create

Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you
Make.

 

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

 

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

title: Production Director – Seasonal Content | MONOPOLY GO!
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a Production Director – Seasonal Content to join our MONOPOLY GO! team. This role can be based remotely in the UK or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis.</p> <p>MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—whether through our work alongside exceptional teammates or through unforgettable experiences for millions of players. We're a global team of game makers building one of the world's most successful live-service games.</p> <p>As the Production Director – Seasonal Content, you'll own the operational health, planning, and execution behind MONOPOLY GO!'s seasonal content portfolio. You'll partner across Art, Design, Product, Live Operations, Licensing, and Content teams to ensure every season delivers exceptional quality, creative novelty, operational excellence, and measurable player impact.</p> <p>Success in this role goes beyond shipping content on schedule. You'll be accountable for the health of the seasonal ecosystem—including content capacity, creative ambition, production predictability, IP integration, execution quality, and the cross-functional alignment required to consistently deliver industry-leading live-service seasons.</p> <p>This role requires an exceptional balance of strategic leadership and tactical execution. You'll be equally comfortable shaping long-term organizational strategy with senior leadership as you are rolling up your sleeves with producers, artists, designers, and engineers to solve production challenges, unblock teams, and improve execution day-to-day.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Lead production for the Seasonal Content organization, overseeing the planning, execution, and successful delivery of every MONOPOLY GO! season.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the seasonal portfolio, balancing player experience, content quality, novelty, production predictability, resource utilization, and business objectives—not simply delivery against schedule.</li> <li>Drive the long-term evolution of the seasonal content pipeline, continuously improving how art, design, narrative, gameplay content, rewards, licensed IP, localization, and live operations move from concept through launch.</li> <li>Own content roadmap planning, art capacity planning, outsourcing strategy, and resource forecasting to maximize both creative ambition and sustainable execution.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Art, Design, Live Operations, Marketing, and Licensing leadership to align priorities across multiple concurrent seasonal initiatives.</li> <li>Operate comfortably at both the executive and production floor levels—providing strategic direction while remaining actively involved in milestone reviews, dependency management, issue resolution, production planning, and critical decision making.</li> <li>Be willing to get "in the weeds" with producers and development teams to remove blockers, resolve ambiguity, improve workflows, and ensure teams have what they need to succeed.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional planning for major seasonal launches, proactively identifying execution risks, staffing challenges, dependency conflicts, and operational gaps before they impact delivery.</li> <li>Drive executive-level visibility through clear reporting, production health metrics, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Champion continuous improvement across production methodologies, governance, tooling, AI adoption, and content development workflows.</li> <li>Lead organizational change initiatives that improve how teams plan, collaborate, and execute, ensuring new processes are successfully adopted across multiple disciplines.</li> <li>Serve as a diplomatic leader who builds trust across diverse teams, navigates competing priorities with empathy, and facilitates alignment during high-pressure or ambiguous situations.</li> <li>Mentor Production Managers and Producers while raising the overall maturity and effectiveness of production across the Seasonal Content organization.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience leading production within large-scale live-service game development environments.</li> <li>Deep expertise managing content-heavy production pipelines, including art production, outsourcing, IP development, localization, approvals, and live seasonal releases.</li> <li>Demonstrated success operating as a Production Director or equivalent leader responsible for both organizational strategy and execution.</li> <li>Proven ability to seamlessly shift between strategic leadership and hands-on production management, remaining deeply connected to execution while guiding long-term organizational direction.</li> <li>Strong expertise in production planning, capacity planning, portfolio management, dependency mapping, forecasting, and operational excellence.</li> <li>Exceptional understanding of creative development pipelines and how to optimize art and content production without sacrificing quality or innovation.</li> <li>Outstanding diplomacy and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve conflict constructively, and build alignment across diverse disciplines without relying on direct authority.</li> <li>Experience leading organizations through meaningful operational change, including introducing new production processes, organizational structures, tools, or ways of working while driving strong adoption.</li> <li>Excellent judgment balancing player experience, creative ambition, technical constraints, production risk, and business priorities.</li> <li>Outstanding communication, organizational leadership, and relationship-building skills.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with rapidly evolving priorities and complex cross-functional organizations.</li> <li>Passion for building high-performing teams, enabling creative excellence, and delivering unforgettable seasonal experiences at world-class scale.</li> </ul> <h3>AI Capability &amp; Readiness</h3> <p>We believe AI will fundamentally transform how content organizations operate. In this role, you'll be expected to actively incorporate AI into production workflows to improve planning, asset tracking, documentation, communication, forecasting, content review, dependency management, and operational decision-making. You'll champion thoughtful AI adoption across the Seasonal Content organization, helping teams work faster, make better decisions, and increase creative capacity without compromising quality. We value leaders who are curious, experimental, and capable of driving organizational change as AI reshapes game development.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working on category-leading live service games.</li> <li>Experience within mobile free-to-play game development.</li> <li>Experience leading globally distributed development teams.</li> <li>Experience scaling production organizations during periods of rapid growth.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern AI productivity tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar, and experience applying them to production workflows.</li> <li>Experience evolving production operating models, governance frameworks, or portfolio planning processes.</li> </ul> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!&nbsp; &nbsp;We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h2><strong>Introduction&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for an experienced Mechatronics Engineer to join our world class engineering team. You will be working on projects in the Healthcare sectors that shape the worlds technological advancements in Mechatronics Design.</p> <h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>We are a product design consultancy that specialises in deep tech. Clients come to us to develop world first solutions and products that cannot be easily copied by me-too imitators. We serve a wide range of industries, including green energy, consumer goods, communications, healthcare and wellbeing, agriculture and food and beverages, with offices and clients around the world.</p> <p>As part of our talented mechatronics team, you’ll design ground-breaking mechanical equipment that improves lives worldwide. Your work will shape the future of healthcare and advance your own expertise through hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology.</p> <h3><strong>The Role&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Most of your time will be focused on delivering the best Mechatronic hardware design possible for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You’ll be hands on in solving tough mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, and in supportive project teams. You’d be working on projects across a range of healthcare sectors including Lifesciences, Diagnostics, Bioinnovation, Drug Delivery and Surgical. The technical challenges we work on are often ground-breaking and seriously change the landscape of Heathcare. We’d love you to be a part of that.</p> <p>Our work varies greatly for our clients, but it’s likely you’ll be leading work such as first-principle engineering analyses, hands on testing and experimentation, detailed machine design and implementation, and liaising with suppliers. Your experience in these areas means you’ll be able to design systems and parts for manufacture with real world knowledge. You’ll be leading Mechatronics developments and defining technical solutions. And helping mentor and develop junior engineers within your field of expertise.</p> <p>Our culture encourages team members to develop their responsibility that suits them and you’ll have the opportunity to significantly develop your skills and career, learn from others and make substantial impact on our projects. &nbsp;</p> <p>We have a lot of content on our projects on our website, some relevant examples can be found here:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/breakthrough-innovation-for-smaller-more-capable-surgical-robotics/">Breakthrough innovation for smaller, more capable surgical robotics</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/next-generation-autoinjectors/">Next generation autoinjectors</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/omniscia-superhuman-surgery-in-real-time/">Omniscia: superhuman surgery in real time</a></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What can you bring?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>You will bring an impressive Mechatronics ability and enthusiasm to the role. title: Senior Human-Centric AI Engineer
description: <h3><strong>Overview</strong></h3> <p>Cambridge Consultants’ Human-Machine Understanding (HMU) group is looking for an engineer to work at the intersection of AI, cognitive science, and human-machine interaction. This is an exciting opportunity to take an active role in the group’s mission to build the next generation of intuitive human interactive technologies.</p> <p>HMU is building the technical framework of Intelligent Interfaces for modern digital and physical AI: a dedicated layer of intelligence that enables machines to perceive, reason about, and adapt to human behaviour and intent in real time. We apply this approach to diverse use cases, from robotics and automation in industrial and consumer settings, to agentic coaches and AI assistants in sports and healthcare. This is an opportunity to take ownership of technical ideas and shape the trajectory of an emerging capability.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer</strong></h3> <p>This is a high-autonomy role within the Human-Machine Understanding team in CC’s Intelligent Services business. As part of an emerging capability, you will have a mandate to explore and push the boundaries of the state-of-the-art in human-interactive AI. You will be involved in client projects as well as internal investment research projects to shape the future of our capability.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the technical realization of our HMU framework, encompassing multi-modal human sensing and fusion, human-centric contextual modelling, and agentic workflows that can leverage this context to support human users proactively<strong>.</strong> Your work will involve navigating the art of the possible, deriving insights from diverse fields such as Psychology and Cognitive Science, Affective Computing, Human-Robot Interaction, and Cognitive Robotics, and turning them into robust, real-world interactive AI pipelines.</p> <p>We are a nurturing team. You will be supported to develop your career in the direction you want, with mentoring and training provided. Opportunities for development and progression are varied and will be tailored to the interests, experience, and skills of the successful candidate, with scope to develop increased technical, commercial, and/or programme expertise and leadership.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Deliver on diverse client projects, from designing and running human subjects’ studies for science-backed HMI/HRI design, to technical development of novel interfaces and interaction paradigms.</li> <li>Conduct technical research focused on understanding the art of the possible in human-machine understanding and translating it into robust industrial solutions through technical prototypes.</li> <li>Proactively identify opportunities to apply HMU across CC’s diverse markets, building the demos and prototypes that showcase our leadership in this space.</li> <li>Work with colleagues across Cambridge Consultants to translate deep technical insights into compelling narratives and functional systems for our clients, and academic audiences.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a candidate who thrives on technical ambiguity and possesses the drive to build independently across disciplines:</p> <ul> <li>An excellent degree or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Cognitive Science, Psychology or a related field with emphasis on computational modelling or AI.</li> <li>High proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch). You should be comfortable building and debugging complex, real-time systems.</li> <li>Prior experience of human subject research; from experiment protocol and methodology development, to conducting experiments, analysis of data and synthesis of insights. Experience with ethics committees is highly valued.&nbsp;</li> <li>The ability to work independently, driving your own curiosity to explore new topics and proactively building prototypes that demonstrate your ideas.</li> </ul> <p>In addition, any of the following is highly desired:</p> <ul> <li>Proven experience technical realization of HRI/HCI systems, such as cognitive architectures, multi-modal perception pipelines, or affective computing.</li> <li>Experience with agentic AI workflows, knowledge graphs, and complex state-machine architectures.</li> <li>Track record of publications in relevant conferences (e.g. ICRA, IROS, HRI, NeurIPS, ICML), and/or academic journals (e.g. IEEE Transactions).</li> <li>Development of software for distributed real-time physical systems or robotics (e.g., ROS2).</li> </ul> <p>We are recruiting multiple people under this vacancy. Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. One of these roles requires you to obtain a Security Check level security clearance (<a href="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant">https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant</a>). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Examples of projects undertaken by the team:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Building contextual understanding into Physical AI systems for <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/physical-ai-human-robot-interaction/">adaptive human-robot interaction</a></li> <li>Developing human-centric AI to assist with curating <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/ai-powered-music-innovation-to-unlock-a-new-era-in-dementia-care/">personalised music playlists for people living with dementia through behavioural monitoring</a></li> <li>Mapping the <a href="https://www.capgemini.com/insights/research-library/machine-precision-human-intuition-a-new-era-in-human-machine-understanding/">current space and future potential of human-machine understanding</a> with Capgemini</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
