title: Technical Director - Facades & External Walls
description: <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Role can be based in any of our UK offices.</p> <p>Jensen Hughes is a company fiercely committed to our purpose, our clients, and each other. Every single member of our team is essential to our success. Due to the continued growth and success of our External Walls and Facades team, we have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Director: Facades to join our market leading UK team.</p> <p>This role provides senior technical leadership across façade and external wall projects, bridging deep technical expertise with team leadership, quality assurance, and client engagement. You will work closely with the Director of Facades, an additional Technical Director, the Facades team, and the wider Fire Engineering leadership to support the delivery and growth of our façade consultancy services across the UK.</p> <p><strong>The Impact You’ll Make in This Role</strong></p> <p>The successful candidate will provide senior technical leadership and governance across façade and external wall engineering services. The role is responsible for ensuring technical excellence, appropriate risk management, and defensible engineering judgement on complex and high-risk projects.</p> <p>The successful candidate will act as a recognized internal technical authority, supporting project delivery teams, mentoring engineers, and representing Jensen Hughes in senior technical discussions with clients and stakeholders.</p> <p>You will continue to be involved in technically complex projects while also supporting team development, workload management, and consistency of delivery across offices. This role is ideal for a highly experienced façade consultant who enjoys remaining technically engaged while influencing standards, people, and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a senior technical authority for façade and external wall systems, including fire performance, testing, appraisal, and remediation strategies.</li> <li>Provide technical oversight, peer review, and sign-off for complex and high-risk façade deliverables.</li> <li>Ensure façade engineering advice is proportionate, risk-based, and aligned with relevant legislation, guidance, and internal governance requirements.</li> <li>Lead the technical approach on complex façade and external wall appointments.</li> <li>Represent Jensen Hughes in senior technical discussions with clients, design teams, contractors, and regulators.</li> <li>Identify, assess, and manage technical risk across façade and external wall projects.</li> <li>Support the development and application of internal technical standards, guidance notes, and quality assurance processes.</li> <li>Mentor and support engineers across the façade and external wall team, contributing to capability development and performance review.</li> <li>Support the Director – Facades in service line development, including technical input to fee strategy, workload planning, and resourcing.</li> <li>Contribute to maintaining Jensen Hughes’ reputation for high-quality, independent technical advice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>If successful, here is what we will expect from you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Delivery of high-quality, defensible technical advice on complex projects.</li> <li>Effective technical governance, peer review, and risk management.</li> <li>Positive client feedback and repeat appointments.</li> <li>Demonstrated development and progression of technical staff.</li> <li>Contribution to the strength and credibility of the façade and external wall service line.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree qualified in Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent demonstrable experience).</li> <li>Chartered or working towards chartership (desirable).</li> <li>Extensive experience in façade and/or external wall engineering.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgement on complex and high-risk projects.</li> <li>Strong understanding of façade systems, materials, construction techniques, and performance.</li> <li>Experience in technical governance, peer review, and quality assurance.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly to clients and stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience mentoring and supporting engineers at varying levels.</li> <li>Willingness to travel to project sites across the UK as required.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-SG1 #LI-hybrid</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.&nbsp; We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.&nbsp; Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.&nbsp; Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA.&nbsp; Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>*Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements<br><br>Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to “staffing firms” or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager -  Gateway, Devices & Vertical Solutions
description: <p>We're looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for NMI's Gateway product line, with a focus on card-present devices and vertical markets such as unattended retail, parking, medical, and beyond.</p> <p>This role sits at the center of product, sales, and marketing, translating platform and device capabilities into compelling, solution-forward value propositions that resonate with the operators, partners, and buyers within each vertical. You will own market positioning, messaging, launches, and enablement for NMI's Gateway, device, and unattended solutions, ensuring NMI is the preferred payments partner across every vertical it serves.</p> <p>This role requires a strong understanding of how vertical markets evaluate and adopt payment technology, and the ability to explain the value proposition and competitive advantages of NMI's solutions in terms that matter to each vertical, not just the technical specifications of the hardware or gateway itself. You'll help shape how partners, integrators and operators in card-present verticals, in particular the unattended (transportation, parking, vending, etc) space, understand, evaluate, and succeed with NMI, while supporting revenue teams with clear, differentiated, outcome-focused messaging that drives pipeline and adoption. Success in this role looks like partners, integrators and operators understanding how NMI's applications help their business succeed, not a list of device features.</p> <p>This role is also NMI's evangelist for these solutions. You'll present directly to sales teams, internal and external stakeholders, and prospects, and represent NMI at trade shows, conferences, and other industry events, including external speaking opportunities and briefings with industry analysts. You'll build AI tools into your everyday workflow as a core habit rather than an occasional add-on, and bring enough technical depth across gateways, devices, APIs, and certification processes to hold your own in a room with engineers and technical buyers, not just repeat what they tell you.</p> <h3>About NMI</h3> <p>NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.</p> <h3><strong>How We Work - Our Core Values</strong></h3> <p>* <strong>Be a Good Person, It's Simple.</strong> We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus</p> <p>* <strong>Align, Trust &amp; Go.</strong> We debate openly, &nbsp;listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.</p> <p>* <strong>Raise the Bar.</strong> Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively.&nbsp;We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p><strong>Own Gateway, Device &amp; Vertical Go-to-Market Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead positioning and messaging for NMI's Gateway product line across device and vertical segments, including medical, unattended retail, parking, and other emerging verticals.</li> <li>Define clear, solution-forward value propositions for each vertical's buyers and operators, grounded in the business outcomes NMI's applications enable and revenue generation rather than device or technical specifications alone.</li> <li>Develop differentiated narratives that articulate why NMI is the payments partner of choice for each vertical, moving away from feature-and-spec language in favor of stories about partner and operator success.</li> <li>Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap decisions using vertical market insight and competitive intelligence. Be the customer and go-to-market expert who drives adoption of our Gateway and device solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive Product Launches &amp; Market Adoption</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end go-to-market execution for new Gateway features, devices, and vertical-specific enhancements.</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally across product, sales, corporate marketing, and channel marketing to ensure successful launch execution.</li> <li>Create launch plans, enablement materials, customer-facing messaging, and internal readiness programs that speak to each vertical's priorities and pain points.</li> <li>Support adoption and revenue generation by aligning messaging with onboarding, documentation, and the operator experience within each vertical.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deeply Understand Vertical &amp; Device Ecosystems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the in-house expert on buyer and operator personas within medical, unattended, parking, transportation and other priority verticals.</li> <li>Conduct market research to understand trends in device commerce, unattended retail, vertical-specific regulation, and payment application monetization.</li> <li>Monitor competitors and evolving vertical market dynamics to refine NMI's differentiation strategy.</li> <li>Translate ecosystem shifts into actionable, solution-focused messaging and strategic recommendations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build Sales &amp; Channel Enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop high-impact sales enablement tools, including pitch decks, battlecards, case studies, messaging frameworks, ROI narratives, and vertical-specific solution narratives and use cases.</li> <li>Help sales articulate the business value of NMI's Gateway and device solutions in terms each vertical's buyers care about, not just technical capability.</li> <li>Support lifecycle messaging that drives adoption, expansion, and retention among partners across verticals.</li> <li>Partner with channel marketing to equip ISOs, software integrators, and reseller partners with compelling, vertical-focused messaging they can use with confidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Be an Evangelist for NMI's Solutions</strong></p> <ul> <li>Present NMI's Gateway, device, and vertical solutions to sales teams, internal and external stakeholders, partners and prospects, turning positioning into a compelling live narrative that lands in the room.</li> <li>Represent NMI at trade shows, industry events, and conferences, and pursue external speaking opportunities that build NMI's credibility and visibility in the verticals it serves.</li> <li>Build relationships with industry analysts and serve as a credible, technical voice for NMI's Gateway and device story.</li> <li>Bring working technical fluency across gateways, devices, APIs, and certification processes, deep enough to hold your own with engineers, integrators, and technical buyers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Influence Product &amp; Business Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use competitive insight and vertical customer research to influence product packaging, pricing, and positioning decisions.</li> <li>Build business cases to support new vertical market opportunities.</li> <li>Drive alignment across product, engineering, and commercial teams around priority verticals and growth strategy.</li> <li>Success looks like: clear, differentiated positioning across each vertical NMI serves; strong adoption of new Gateway and device launches; increased pipeline contribution and revenue impact from vertical solutions; sales teams confidently articulating NMI's value in each vertical's terms; and product decisions informed by real vertical customer and market insight.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive Thought Leadership &amp; Solution Storytelling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Synthesize vertical customer and market insights into repeatable narratives and frameworks for internal and external use.</li> <li>Partner with content and comms to produce thought leadership (whitepapers, POVs, benchmark reports, keynotes, webinars) centered on how NMI's solutions help each vertical succeed.</li> <li>Contribute to company and industry initiatives (webinars, events, analysts, partners) relevant to priority verticals.</li> </ul> <h3>Experience</h3> <ul> <li>5-8+ years of B2B product marketing experience in payments, fintech, devices/hardware-enabled commerce, or vertical SaaS.</li> <li>Direct experience marketing payment gateways, devices, or unattended/vertical solutions (e.g., unattended retail, kiosks, vending, parking, medical, or similar verticals).</li> <li>Strong ability to translate technical or device capabilities into solution-forward, outcome-based messaging for non-technical operators and buyers.</li> <li>Proven success leading cross-functional product and device launches.</li> <li>Ability to move a product's narrative from feature and spec-led to solution and outcome-led, and to bring sales and channel teams along with that shift.</li> <li>Experience supporting both direct sales and channel/reseller (ISO) go-to-market motions.</li> <li>Comfortable and effective presenting live to sales teams, prospects, and internal/external stakeholders, including at trade shows, conferences, and analyst briefings.</li> <li>Uses AI tools as an integrated part of daily PMM work (research, content, competitive analysis, enablement production), not as an occasional add-on.</li> <li>Strong storytelling, messaging, speaking and content development skills.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Marketing or other related field, MBA a plus.</li> </ul> <h3>Essential Skills</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Strategist</strong> - You combine classic strategic marketing skills with experience in multi-channel marketing/distribution, have perspective, and can see and discuss multiple aspects and impacts of issues and project them into the future.</li> <li><strong>Strong external and internal leader</strong> - You collaborate well cross-functionally with key internal partners, work effectively with external partners to identify potential joint marketing opportunities, and have a willingness to learn and coach.</li> <li><strong>Business Savvy</strong> - You possess a technical understanding of devices, gateways, and the payments space, have a high degree of business acumen, and provide consistent, accurate information.</li> <li><strong>Master Communicator</strong> - You have the ability to distill complex and difficult information into easy to understand communications. In other words, you can easily "de-geek the speak" with your exceptional creative and communication skills.</li> <li><strong>Influencer</strong> - You have demonstrated superior relationship-building and influence management skills in interactions with senior leaders, peers, internal and external partners.</li> <li><strong>Flexible</strong> - You not only cope with change, you thrive on it and can shift gears comfortably.</li> <li><strong>Driven</strong> - You are results-oriented with a positive outlook and a clear focus on quality and business performance.</li> <li><strong>Solution Oriented</strong> - You have the ability to identify and creatively solve complex problems.</li> <li><strong>Personable</strong> - You are positive, energetic, and exude a strong sense of teamwork by working effectively, respectfully, and efficiently with all team members.</li> <li><strong>Courageous and Ethical</strong> - You possess professional courage, steadfastly persevere through challenges, are ambitious while humble, have high standards for ethics and integrity, and do the right things the right way.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Skills and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Experience marketing into unattended retail, parking, medical/healthcare, or other device-driven verticals.</li> <li>Experience with payment gateways, terminals, or IoT/connected device commerce.</li> <li>Experience managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience shifting a product's go-to-market from a technical, spec-driven story to a solution and outcome-driven story.</li> <li>Experience working with ISOs, resellers, or channel partners on vertical-specific enablement.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Annual salary of £75,000 - £100,000</li> <li>Annual bonus scheme dependent on individual and company performance&nbsp;</li> <li>25 days holiday each year (+ bank holidays + 1 day after each year of service with up to a max. of 30 days)</li> <li>Workplace pension scheme</li> <li>Private medical insurance (upon 30 days of employment)</li> <li>7 hours per day, 35 hours per week</li> <li>A remote first culture</li> <li>Great work-life balance with our Flexi-time policy</li> <li>Family Friendly policies (Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Pay and Shared Parental Leave).</li> <li>A chance to develop with an allocated company training budget</li> <li>Bike2Work Scheme</li> <li>Lifeworks, an Employee Assistance Programme which offers wellbeing, family and financial support services, such as assessments, resources and even 1:1 counselling sessions. It also offers interesting perks such as discounts on gyms, restaurants, high street retailers and cinema tickets</li> <li>A strong commitment to employee wellbeing including mental health first aiders</li> <li>Employee referral scheme with generous financial reward</li> <li>Bonusly colleague reward scheme</li> </ul> <p><em>We’re looking for creative and passionate people who share our vision of making payments easy. If that sounds like you and you meet the requirements above, then please click on 'Apply for this job'!</em></p> <p>We are an Equal Opportunities employer and will provide reasonable support throughout the recruitment process to applicants who have a disability. raw.title: Bid Manager
raw.description:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive, both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Bid Manager, you'll own how Ben wins enterprise deals through tenders and RFPs. Enterprise is where Ben's growth is, and tenders are how that growth happens. Right now, AEs and Solutions teams are stretched across bid work and new business. You'll take ownership of the bid process so they can focus on closing new business.

You'll write and shape responses, orchestrate inputs from Legal, Product, Security, and Commercial teams, and make sure Ben shows up with the right story, at the right depth, every time.

Reporting to our COO, you will influence how we work across every major enterprise deal. This is a high-visibility role with direct influence on how Ben is perceived by our biggest prospects.

What you'll be working on

  • Owning our bid process end-to-end: from the moment an RFP lands to the moment it's submitted. Intake, content production, review cycles, submission, and post-submission follow-up

  • Proposal writing and editorial oversight: you’ll know what depth buyers need, what story to tell at each stage, and what a procurement team actually reads versus what they skip

  • Bid qualification and prioritisation: not every tender is worth the investment. You'll assess where to put limited capacity and when to walk away

  • Turning win/loss data into better bids: bid scoring feedback, patterns across tenders, what landed and what didn't. You'll feed that back into the process so Ben gets sharper with every submission

  • Commercial and pricing review: you won't set pricing, but you'll pull the right numbers together, flag unusual commercial terms, and make sure the bid is commercially sound before it goes out

  • Sales Enablement: our commercial will work with you to contribute to bids. You'll make that easy by giving them clear briefs, tight deadlines, and templates so they know exactly what good input looks like

You'll love this role if you have...

  • Experience running RFP and tender processes in B2B SaaS or enterprise software: you've seen the full cycle and know the operating rhythm

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent bids under pressure: this will be a lean team, working across a variety of global bid processes

  • Familiarity with enterprise procurement: compliance requirements, evaluation criteria, panel processes etc.

  • Built or significantly developed a bid function before: this is a new function at Ben - help us build it!


And you...

  • Think with an AI-native mindset: you are already using AI to automate as much of your workflow as possible, and have thought deeply about how your role is evolving with AI in mind

  • Have great taste and design sensitivity: You know what great looks like, and what will stand out visually in front of our prospective clients

  • Have excellent writing skills: you can translate a complex product into clear, persuasive responses that land with procurement teams and C-suite evaluators

You will not love this role if you….

  • Need a slow pace to feel comfortable: we move fast, and we prioritise action, even when the path isn’t perfectly clear

  • Are uncomfortable being accountable for outcomes: this role involves owning projects end-to-end and being responsible for making them succeed and delivering them at a high quality

  • Prefer maintaining the status quo: we want to challenge assumptions and push for better ways of working

  • Prefer a highly structured environment with established processes and clearly defined boundaries: we’re still building, and sometimes that means creating the path as we go

Why join us?

Tenders are the key to enterprise growth at Ben. This function directly drives how we win our biggest deals, and you'll be the first person to own it.

You'll have real influence. You're working with C-level stakeholders internally and externally, shaping how Ben shows up in every major deal. The reporting line is directly to the COO, across every enterprise opportunity.

Ben is an AI-fluent company. You'll build this function in an environment where AI tooling is already part of how the team works. The bid process you design here will be built for that world from day one.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here.

💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build

⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance

💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250

🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!

🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 5 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!

🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme, so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones.

🍼 Enhanced parental leave and workplace nursery scheme to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting

❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance

💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. This also includes an annual health check

🧠 Comprehensive mental health support and professional coaching through a leading provider

title: Platform Engineer
description: We are recruiting a Platform Engineer to join us in our London office. Our mission is to make first contact with superintelligence. We are creating a superlearner that discovers all knowledge from its own experience, from elementary motor skills through to profound intellectual breakthroughs. This superlearning capability - the ability to endlessly discover knowledge and skills, without relying on human data - will be driven by the world’s most powerful reinforcement learning algorithms. The superlearner is expected to rediscover and then transcend the greatest inventions in human history, such as language, science, mathematics and technology. If successful, this will represent a scientific breakthrough of comparable magnitude to Darwin: where his law explained all life, our law will explain and build all intelligence. Role brief As a foundational hire on the platform team, you'll be joining at a point where individual decisions shape how the platform is designed, not just maintained. This isn't a role where you inherit someone else's architecture, you'll be one of the people defining it. We're pushing these learning methods to a scale that hasn’t been tried before and we care deeply about the infrastructure that gets us there. You'll own the infrastructure that the mission depends on; keeping large-scale GPU compute reliable, developer environments fast and the whole platform humming. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be a part of defining a new paradigm in AI and wants their work to directly speed up the experimentation and progress of our ambitious research. This is a broad role, and the list below is non-exhaustive. You’ll be empowered to shape the role how you’d like in order to best enable our mission. Kubernetes and containers: manage clusters and deploy internal tools GPU scheduling at scale : hands-on with tools like KAI scheduler and Kueue to keep thousands of GPUs busy and productive Making large-scale infrastructure resilient: get to the root of hardware failures and cluster-scale chaos, building the systems that prevent them from recurring Cloud infrastructure: experience on Google Cloud and other major providers Observability that actually helps: log management and monitoring with tools like QuickWit, Grafana or Datadog Developer environments people love: tooling like Tailscale, Workbrew and dev containers that make everyone's day-to-day faster Clean, well-crafted code: e.g. Python and Rust for tools and infrastructure that are a joy to build on We move fast, give people real ownership and trust engineers to make good judgment calls. We are a team that cares as much about doing this well as doing it fast. If you're interested in joining Ineffable and think your skills would be better suited to a different position please express your interest to the Member of Technical Staff (Research / Engineering) position. You'll own the full engineering scope of a serious ClickHouse estate: cluster operations and upgrades, schema and sorting-key design, materialised views, ingestion performance, query optimisation, workload isolation, capacity planning, storage tiering, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and production support. You'll also set direction and work on the data pipelines around the plant — our capture services are Go, and our analytics foundation is Python.

Beyond your own technical ownership, you'll set the standard for how the estate is run, mentor the engineers who work alongside you, and ensure the plant is genuinely supportable by a team rather than dependent on any one person — including yourself.

You don't need years of ClickHouse specifically — deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series database qualifies you, and a strong columnar engineer learns our estate quickly. What we do need is genuine operational depth: you have run a production data platform, owned its capacity plan and its recovery procedures, and stayed calm when it mattered.

This hire helps create a follow-the-sun team — so the platform is supported across time zones rather than by heroics. On-call is a shared, contracted responsibility, planned and paid — not goodwill.

What You'll Work On

  • Cluster operations at scale — running, upgrading and evolving a multi-AZ ClickHouse estate on Kubernetes, with rehearsed backup and recovery

  • Schema and query engineering — table and sorting-key design, partitioning, materialised views, and query optimisation against multi-terabyte datasets

  • Capacity and observability — a measured capacity model, storage tiering and retention, and the Grafana monitoring and alerting that keeps the plant's health visible

  • Ingestion and data quality — correctness and completeness gates on the pipelines feeding the plant; reconciliation that proves nothing was dropped

  • Workload isolation — keeping ingest, operations, reporting and ad-hoc analytics from treading on each other as read load grows

  • Team and knowledge leadership — mentoring the engineer(s) working on the estate, setting standards for runbooks and documentation, and making the plant supportable by the team, not the author

  • AI-assisted operations — modern tooling (including MCP-based AI access to the estate) that lets a small team run a large platform well

What We Need

Technical:

  • Columnar/OLAP database engineering — ClickHouse strongly preferred; deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series store (BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, kdb+ or similar) also works

  • A track record of owning architectural decisions for a production data platform, not just operating within one someone else designed

  • SQL depth — execution plans, query optimisation, and schema design for very large datasets

  • Operational/SRE experience — you have carried production responsibility for a data platform: monitoring, capacity, incidents, recovery

  • Linux and Kubernetes — comfort with the operational layer beneath the database

  • A programming language — one of Python, Go, R, or MATLAB (Python preferred)

  • Engineering discipline — you write proposals, strategies, and architectural documents and diagrams well, and you manage change properly

  • Git — excellent version-control practice

  • Distributed-systems fundamentals — replication, consistency, failure modes

  • Financial services experience is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; operational instinct cannot

How you work:

  • You own production. Calm in an incident, rigorous in a post-mortem, honest about what nearly went wrong

  • You measure first. Topology, storage and optimisation decisions follow observed load and cost — not fashion

  • You write things down. Runbooks, schema documentation and clean handovers are part of the craft

  • You share knowledge deliberately. The goal is a platform supportable by a team, not a specialist

  • You communicate across time zones. Follow-the-sun only works with clear, proactive handovers

  • You embrace AI as a tool. You use it to amplify your own effectiveness and help shape how it operates safely around production data

What You Get

  • A serious estate — genuine scale, genuine criticality: the system of record for a live trading network, not a reporting sidecar

  • Real ownership — architectural and technical leadership of a business-critical core platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Sustainable operations — follow-the-sun coverage by design; on-call is shared, contracted and planned, not heroics

  • Competitive package — competitive compensation and benefits aligned to your local market

  • Modern tooling — AI-assisted operations and investigation tooling that removes toil rather than adding process

  • Growth — the estate is scaling to multiples of today's volume; the role grows with it

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

raw.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
raw.description:
Lead Frontend Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to own our Frontend team — the full-stack application engineers who build the trading platform our clients use. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role. The team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.

This is a player-coach role. You'll still write code, review the work that matters, and make the architectural calls that keep the platform fast and maintainable — while owning the team's delivery, its standards, and the development of the engineers in it. The role only works if you can hold two things at once: hands on the platform (credible to your engineers because you understand the work) and off the critical path (leading with depth and raising the team up, so nothing depends on you alone at the keyboard).

You'd be the clear owner of this team — responsibility for it is currently shared informally across our CDO, our Head of Technical Delivery, and the most senior engineer. Part of the job is to take that on, close out the informal cover, and build a team that runs under its own steam. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you lead the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Driving the technical direction of the frontend application stack — architecture, standards, and the trade-offs that keep the platform fast and maintainable

  • Hands-on TypeScript and Rust — building and reviewing the most critical or complex work yourself

  • Real-time, data-dense trading interfaces across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, and the application services behind them

  • Owning code quality across the team through review, design sessions, and the standards you set and enforce

  • Developing the engineers on the team — technical craft and the non-coding skills that let people scale

  • Shaping the roadmap with the CTO, CDO, Technical Delivery, and Client facing teams, and turning priorities into delivered software

  • Ensuring the team owns its Level 3 support, observability, and operational readiness — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong full-stack engineering background with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years, including time leading or setting technical direction for a team)

  • Familiarity with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of Rust, or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols) — you understand what it takes to build software that's fast and reliable under load

  • Able to make and defend architectural decisions, and explain the trade-offs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology

How you lead:

  • You lead by example. You write code, review designs, and hold the highest standards. Engineers respect a lead who understands the work, not one who manages it from a distance

  • You build strength across the team. You know when to be hands-on and when to step back. You lead with depth and raise the others up, rather than being the single point of failure

  • You own it. You take responsibility for the team's delivery, quality, and production reliability — not just your own output. When something breaks, you lead the investigation and fix

  • You develop people. You invest time in mentoring and growing the team, and you can point to engineers who are better for having worked with you

  • You're direct and honest. You give specific, timely feedback, and you hold a quality line without becoming a bottleneck

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially during incidents and in stakeholder updates — is essential

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build the trading platform our clients use every day. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role — our Frontend team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who takes on the hardest problems and delivers them under their own steam. You'll own complex, ambiguous, performance-critical work end-to-end — designed, built, tested, deployed, and supported in production. You lead through code, craft, and mentoring, setting the technical example the rest of the team calibrates to. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Complex full-stack features in TypeScript and Rust — from trader-facing interfaces to the application services behind them

  • Real-time market-data presentation and high-throughput, low-latency application code across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency

  • React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) for demanding, data-dense trading interfaces

  • Distributed systems and real-time data over REST, WebSockets, and network protocols

  • Architecture and solution design for the hardest technical problems the team faces

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make frontend behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong full-stack engineering ability with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years)

  • Solid experience with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of Rust, or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols such as TCP/UDP and binary protocols)

  • Comfortable reasoning about architecture and making defensible technical trade-offs

  • Python for scripting, automation, and tooling is a bonus

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You run with things. Give you an ambiguous, complex problem and you drive it to done without being managed through it. Senior here means trusted, not just experienced

  • You have range. You're not just strong in the familiar parts of the stack — you pick up the unfamiliar and hold your own on the hardest work

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You review peers' work thoughtfully, mentor the engineers around you through the craft, and set a standard others calibrate to

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. raw.description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

title: Senior Prop Artist
description: About the Role Genesis AI is building Genesis World, a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house path traced photorealistic renderer that powers the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. We are looking for a Senior Prop Artist to model, sculpt, and texture the physical objects and digital twins that populate our simulated worlds. Because these assets are used as training data for machines operating in the physical world, close enough is not enough, meaning scale, proportion, material response, and geometric accuracy must all hold up under scrutiny. This is a craft heavy role where you will apply game caliber art skills beyond entertainment to build beautiful, efficient assets that perform in real time and directly narrow the gap between simulation and reality. What You'll Do Create photoreal props for digital twins end-to-end: modeling, high-poly sculpting, retopology, UVs, and PBR texturing. Recreate real-world objects from reference and photogrammetry, matching real dimensions, materials, and wear. Clean up, retopologize, and optimize scanned and existing assets to meet real-time budgets without losing fidelity. Author assets to strict poly, texture, and memory budgets suited to GPU-accelerated real-time rendering. Partner with rendering and physics engineers to make sure assets are visually and physically correct in-engine. Maintain consistency, naming, and quality standards across a growing library of props. What We're Looking For 5+ years as a prop / hard-surface / environment artist, with shipped work built under AAA real-time engine constraints (games, not VFX). Strong modeling skills in Maya and/or Blender and sculpting expertise in ZBrush. Mastery of PBR texturing in Substance (Painter/Designer). Photogrammetry and scan cleanup experience; comfortable turning raw scans into production-ready assets. Deep understanding of real-time constraints: poly budgets, LODs, texture memory, and optimization tradeoffs. A sharp eye for accuracy, scale, and material fidelity, and the discipline to hit them consistently. Nice to Have Familiarity with real-time / GPU-accelerated rendering pipelines and how assets behave in a path-traced renderer. Interest or background in robotics, embodied AI, or sim-to-real. Our technical stack includes: Splunk for SIEM, investigations, and dashboards; CrowdStrike for EDR and endpoint/workload security; Wiz for cloud security and exposure management; Torq for SOAR and automation; AWS, including modern environments such as EKS/Kubernetes; An in-house developed Agentic SOC for alert enrichment, correlation, investigation support, reporting, and automation. AI is at the heart of how we work: investing in AI applied to security is a strategic priority for Ledger this year. We’ve built our own in-house Agentic SOC, which autonomously investigates weak signals—the large volume of unreliable alerts that a human team couldn’t sort through manually—and enriches them, so our engineers can focus on what matters most and resolve incidents faster: high-quality detection, noise reduction, and accelerated investigations. What you’ll be doing: As a Staff Security Operations Engineer , you are the SecOps team’s top technical expert and our go-to authority on incident management. You lead the response to the most critical and complex incidents (CSIRT), spearhead proactive threat hunting, and define the detection and response strategy that the entire team relies on. Beyond day-to-day operations, you shape the architecture of our detection pipeline, SIEM, and automation—including the management of our internal Agentic SOC—and you establish the standards, playbooks, and methodologies that raise the technical bar for the entire team. This is an expert role (individual contributor): your impact stems from your expertise, your judgment under pressure, and your influence. Critical Incident Response (CSIRT) Serve as the primary point of contact and coordinator for the most complex incidents across the cloud, corporate systems, endpoints, identities, and the data center. Conduct end-to-end investigations: root cause analysis, forensics, timeline reconstruction, and remediation recommendations to prevent recurrence. Serve as the team’s go-to expert in incident management, ensuring a rigorous and consistent approach to handling, escalating, and documenting incidents. Detection Strategy & Threat Hunting Define the team’s detection strategy, architecture, and methodology. Lead proactive threat hunting by leveraging CTI and OSINT to identify and neutralize risks before they impact Ledger. Address the most challenging and emerging detection issues, and translate threat intelligence into concrete improvements in security posture. Architecture & Agentic SOC Design and optimize the SIEM (Splunk) architecture and SOAR (Torq) workflows that underpin effective detection, triage, and response. Bring our Splunk environment up to standard and state-of-the-art: data quality and standardization (CIM), data models, search performance, and detection governance. Build, evolve, and own the architecture of our internal Agentic SOC and our log/data pipeline, and lead the automation of reporting for the SecOps team. Apply deep expertise in cloud security (AWS, EKS/Kubernetes) and Wiz (CSPM/CNAPP) to harden the cloud and prioritize large-scale exposure. Technical Leadership & Mentoring Establish the standards, playbooks, and runbooks that the team relies on. Mentor and foster the technical growth of senior and junior engineers, and act as a force multiplier within SecOps. Work with the Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and Cloud teams to align operational security with the organization’s objectives. What we’re looking for: 9+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, and CSIRT. A strong track record as a technical expert in incident management, threat hunting, and detection engineering. Comfortable working both as an individual contributor and as a team player in a fast-paced cloud and SaaS environment. In-depth expertise in SIEM (ideally Splunk) and SOAR platforms, as well as CTI/OSINT methodologies. Solid knowledge of AWS security (IAM, audit logs, network configurations, workloads, containers, Kubernetes) and cloud security tools (ideally Wiz, CSPM/CNAPP); experience with an EDR (ideally CrowdStrike). Strong incident response and forensics skills, with the ability to conduct complex end-to-end investigations. The ability to automate tasks and reporting using Python, Bash, APIs, GitHub Actions, a SOAR platform, or equivalent. A solid understanding of infrastructure (cloud, networking, containers, CI/CD) and the ability to build and scale: log/data pipelines, integrations, and internal services. A strong interest—or experience—in AI applied to security operations, agent-based workflows, and SOC automation. Rigor and discipline: You follow and improve established processes and ensure consistency in incident handling and reporting; excellent analytical skills, even under pressure. Clear communication of complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams; ability to document thoroughly and escalate issues with the appropriate level of context; awareness of confidentiality and the proper handling of sensitive information. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.

Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build deployment platforms that work everywhere. Design and improve Pelico's deployment architecture across Kubernetes, Docker, single VM, air-gapped environments and private cloud using Terraform, Helm and Ansible.

  • Create a true one-click deployment experience. Standardize installation, upgrades and operational tooling so enterprise customers can deploy Pelico reliably with minimal manual intervention.

  • Improve platform reliability and observability. Build monitoring, diagnostics, self-remediation capabilities and operational runbooks that allow customer IT teams to operate Pelico independently.

  • Participate in production operations. Join the team's on-call rotation, troubleshoot production incidents, and continuously improve platform reliability through operational excellence and automation.

  • Elevate our DevOps platform. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure practices and deployment workflows to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability across the company.

  • Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth. Contribute to initiatives around GovCloud, FedRAMP readiness and deployments for highly regulated aerospace and defense customers.

  • Drive AI-powered infrastructure engineering. Explore agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment, diagnostics and security.

 

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles in high-growth or production environments.

  • Strong experience building and operating cloud and on-premise infrastructure using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm and Ansible.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and modern deployment practices.

  • Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java, and an automation-first mindset.

  • Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation, troubleshooting production incidents, and continuously improving platform reliability.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across Engineering, Product and customer IT teams.

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work, curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows for coding, infrastructure automation, troubleshooting or engineering productivity.

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting enterprise or industrial environments (manufacturing, aerospace, defense or supply chain).

  • Exposure to security, compliance or regulated infrastructure environments (e.g. GovCloud, FedRAMP or air-gapped deployments).

  • Experience in customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering roles.

 

What we offer

  • Work on a highly impactful product that users love!

  • Office locations: In the heart of Paris (75011) and Miami, USA.

  • Stock Options: Available for every employee.

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere.

  • Premium Health Coverage: Up to 70% covered by Pelico (Alan Healthcare).

  • Meal Allowance: €10/day worked, covered at 50% (via Swile card).

  • Transportation Support: 50% public transportation coverage or an equivalent sustainable mobility package.

  • Wellness Benefit: Access to discounted subscription plans for fitness, wellness, and beauty experiences through our partnership with ClassPass.

  • Collaborative Environment: We foster a vibrant, growth-focused workplace where professional development and team connections thrive.

 

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition call (30 min)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45min)

  3. Technical Test onsite: 1h30

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. Offer + References, run in parallel

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself:

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  4. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room.

  • A platform-as-product mindset — you optimize for adoption and others' leverage, and you're comfortable deprecating

  • A track record of leading senior engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

  • Squad-relevant depth — codegen/annotation processors, Kubernetes/IaC/observability, React/design systems, MCP/LSP/agent harnesses, ERP/connectors, or end-user agent UX

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development)

  • Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

  • A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up

  • Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale

  • An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun

  • Hybrid working from our Paris HQ, an international team of 36+ nationalities

Your interview experience
